mechanism_scope: Worker-6 final mechanism adjudication. The paper supports phenotypic antimicrobial/growth-modulation activity, not a direct molecular mechanism of action.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Synthesized candidate milk peptides inhibited bacterial growth at high µg/mL concentrations in in vitro growth assays; this is phenotypic antimicrobial activity rather than direct target or membrane mechanism evidence.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: 11 synthesized candidate peptides from Table 2, especially peptide 5 and peptide 11 for strongest S. aureus/E. coli activity

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Bulk intestinal peptide extracts showed S. aureus inhibitory and B. infantis growth-promoting phenotypes, while the individual synthesized peptides did not reproduce B. infantis growth promotion.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: bulk intestinal peptide extracts and synthesized candidate peptides
